home.title: Is your neighborhood flood-ready?
home.subtitle: Look up a Texas ZIP or tap the map. We query FEMA’s National Flood Hazard Layer (NFHL) at that point, plus live NWS alerts — not an insurance quote.
home.hint: Enter a 5-digit ZIP or click a map pin to see FEMA zone + risk factors.
home.disclaimer: Educational only. FEMA NFHL effective data when available. Not an official flood determination for insurance or lending.
home.lookupError: Could not look up risk. Try another ZIP.
home.nwsNone: No active flood-related NWS alerts in Texas right now.
home.femaFallback: Using demo + NWS (NFHL unavailable at this point)

about.title: About FloodGuard
about.body: FloodGuard Texas is a public-impact portal in the TxBizFinder Intelligence suite. It helps everyday Texans see illustrative flood risk near them — bayous, coast, flash-flood alley — with a map-first experience.
about.sources: FEMA NFHL MapServer (Flood Hazard Zones, layer 28) for point lookups, plus NWS alerts (api.weather.gov). Map pins still use curated demo centroids for browsing. Next: USGS gauges and OpenFEMA claims.
about.suite: Sister apps: TxBizFinder, PermitRadar, ChannelWatch, Emissions Sentinel, PowerPulse Texas.
